title: Invoice fields read right
method: Values the system accepted without a person, on invoices it never trained on (report 23).

title: Payments matched on their own
method: 868 of 984 payment lines posted with no person, 0 wrong (report 27).

title: Valid claims wrongly disputed
method: Same 8 unseen worlds, same claims; each dot is a valid claim disputed (report 37).

title: Deduction reasons understood
method: Wordings no reader trained on, written before scoring (hybrid NB + qwen2.5vl:7b, report 36).

title: Wrong postings when a fault hits
method: A silent 5% fault on 7,019 lines across 8 unseen worlds, 200 replays (report 40).

title: Input changes caught
method: Five injected changes, 8 unseen worlds; false alarms on cash and claims: 0 (report 47).

title: Demand forecast error
method: 30,490 real M5 series, last 8 weeks, scored once after the model was frozen.

title: Weeks inside the 80% range
method: Ranges learned from earlier weeks only; an honest 80% range catches about 80%.

title: Can ML predict promo lift?
method: 167 real price cuts, scored once. It did not beat guessing zero, so it is not shown as a prediction.

title: Lost-sales dollars caught
method: 11,027 stock-outs planted in the last 8 real M5 weeks, scored once. Slow sellers are not catchable weekly.
